{"subject":"Throughput per node for Cassandra-style workloads","body":"Hi Dana,

Congrats on the move to Brightwave AI. Your background at Northwind Payments, where fraud scoring runs on Astra DB, puts you close to the kind of Cassandra-style workload ScyllaDB is built for.

As you shape infrastructure at Brightwave AI, here is one point that may be useful. ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost.

If it would help, I can send a short overview of how teams evaluate that tradeoff. Open to it?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
